{{Quote|We have the hovercade route, Supreme Chancellor.|The Senate Guard captain to Supreme Chancellor Finis Valorum|<ref name="CoD" />}}
This '''individual''' was a [[Captain/Legends|captain]] in the [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guard]] who served on [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum's]] security detail on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Eriadu/Legends|Eriadu]] during the [[Eriadu Trade Summit]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]<ref name="CoD" /> in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].<ref name="tnec">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'' in [[33 BBY/Legends|32.5 BBY]].</ref> Prior to the start of the summit, the captain presented Valorum with a [[Durasheet/Legends|durasheet]] indicating the route of their hovercade towards [[Seswenna Hall/Legends|Seswenna Hall]] were the event was taking place. [[Lieutenant governor/Legends|Lieutenant governor]] [[Wilhuff Tarkin/Legends|Wilhuff Tarkin]], Valorum's host on the planet, asked to see the sheet and approved it, despite thinking that the route was circuitous.<ref name="CoD" />
